summary.one_liner: Zenko is Scality's open source multi-cloud data controller that provides a unified namespace, access API, and search across local and public cloud storage, deployed on Kubernetes.
summary.what_it_does: Zenko presents a unified namespace and access API over data stored locally (Docker volumes or Scality RING) or in public cloud storage such as Amazon S3, Microsoft Azure Blob storage, or Google Cloud Storage. It also provides search capabilities across that data. This repository contains installation resources to deploy the full Zenko stack on the Kubernetes orchestration system. The stack includes nginx, Zenko Cloudserver, the Zenko Backbeat async replication engine, MongoDB, and redis, pre-configured to communicate with each other. The README mentions a production configuration that includes high availability and requires pre-existing volumes, and links to a guide for deploying an HA Kubernetes cluster. The README is brief and points to external documentation for full details.
use_cases: unified access to data across multiple cloud storage providers
replicating data between local storage and public cloud buckets
searching data stored across S3, Azure Blob, and GCS
deploying a multi-cloud storage gateway on Kubernetes
running an S3-compatible endpoint over Docker volumes or Scality RING
how_to_run: Review the Kubernetes installation resources in the repository
Deploy a HA Kubernetes cluster (see README link)
Provide pre-existing volumes for production deployment
Consult the full documentation for installation steps
notable: Unified namespace and access API across local and multi-cloud storage
Kubernetes-based full-stack deployment with HA option
caveats: Full deployment requires a Kubernetes cluster; production setup needs pre-existing volumes
README is brief and defers to external documentation for details
License not stated in the README
